title: Cash home buyer, investor or iBuyer-style service
basis: Recalled general knowledge, 2026-10-22; hosts not re-fetched (UNVERIFIED). The 'we buy houses' space attracts spam and paid directories, so the pack leans on trust sources (BBB, local investor groups, referrers such as probate and divorce professionals).

domainTypes.note: sellers check the BBB before a cash offer
reviews the seller can read; follow its review rules
investor community profile; contribute, do not advertise

patterns.why: a real estate investors or landlords association
a professional who meets sellers in trouble (probate, divorce, elder care, clean-out, movers)

angles: Join the local real estate investors association and the chamber; both list members.
Meet probate, divorce, elder-care and estate-clean-out professionals; a genuine referral partnership is a resources-page link and a source of sellers.
Publish plain guides sellers search for (selling an inherited house, selling with liens, how a cash offer is calculated) and ask local professionals to cite them.
Get named in local news when helping a real situation (with the seller's consent): a house saved from foreclosure, a vacant property revived.
Collect reviews from sellers you closed with on Google, Trustpilot and BBB; follow each platform's rules.
avoid: Paying 'we buy houses' directories that publish only paid listings; they are the spam neighbourhood of this niche.
Hundreds of near-identical city pages to be 'found everywhere'.
Claims such as 'no fees ever' or 'guaranteed offer' on listings if they are not strictly true.
Wholesaling rules differ by state; check the state's licensing and disclosure rules before any listing says 'we buy'.
